items.question: Which divine attributes are ascribed to the lord in this direct invocation?
premises: The addressed deity is called lord of the heart.
The addressed deity is called the great god.
The addressed deity is called the supreme and ancient lord.
items.inference: The invocation identifies the addressee as an immanent, supreme, and primordial divine lord.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of this vocative sequence within the surrounding passage is not fully determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O lord of the heart, O great god, O supreme lord, O ancient one.
